## Five Public Repositories (GitHub: https://github.com/JupiterIsland)
1. **`JupiterIsland/memoryos`** (Public • HTML / Systems)
   - "A tiered memory engine for local AI. TLB + Temporal Graph + NVMe checkpoints. Built for NVIDIA, architected for AMD Helios. No cloud."
2. **`JupiterIsland/rjmedia`** (Public • HTML / Archive)
   - RJMedia music archive landing page and project files.
3. **`JupiterIsland/music-getaway`** (Public • Python)
   - Python-based tools, scripts, and workflows for musical archives and audio discovery.
4. **`JupiterIsland/.github`** (Public)
   - Organization profile, community health files, and GitHub workflows.
5. **`JupiterIsland/archive-signal`** (Public • MIT License)
   - Preserves and showcases rare music documentaries, broadcast recordings, interviews, restored footage, and cultural archives, bringing context, discovery, and community to independent music history.

## Unified AI Infrastructure (Three Core Systems)
Richard John Murray designs and runs a unified, local-first AI infrastructure built around consumer GPUs, Docker, WSL2, Linux, and Windows automation:

1. **MemoryOS (Memory Engine & Routing Layer)**
   - Handles GPU-aware memory routing, hierarchical tier management, and checkpoint persistence.
   - Prevents context loss and eliminates redundant computation across long-horizon workflows.

2. **Jupiter One Hardware Reality (Hardware & Scheduling Layer)**
   - Provides real-time VRAM telemetry and analysis, hardware ROI recommendations, and multi-model scheduling across consumer GPUs.
   - Grounds model selection and concurrency decisions in physical hardware constraints rather than guesswork.

3. **The Quiet Advisor (Observation & Daily Insight Engine)**
   - Passively observes inference patterns and real workflow telemetry.
   - Runs ten specialized detector algorithms nightly to expose bottlenecks, waste, and hidden usage patterns.
   - Generates **one actionable insight per day** based on actual usage data, teaching users how to use their own tools better.

## Technical Focus & Stack
- **Core Specializations:** Inference optimization, GPU efficiency, multi-model orchestration, competitive model testing, and workflow pattern detection.
- **Engineering Philosophy:** Build systems that reveal waste, improve throughput, and eliminate guesswork.
- **Environment & Tooling:** Docker, WSL2, Linux, Windows automation, consumer GPU runtimes, and multi-model benchmarking.

## Cultural Preservation & Music Archiving (2001–Present)
- Founded the **MansunMusicLovers** Yahoo! Group on 15 December 2001 (148 members), followed by the historic fan archives *pauldraper.tk*, *pauldraper-music.co.uk*, and *Paul-Draper.net*.
- Preserved 25 years of Mansun and Paul Draper history, including 35 era news dispatches (2003–2012), the 3-page 2006 PD-Music Forum Q&A, 1992 Grind videos and MP3s, 1998 *Six* Soundmasters reference inlays and Paul Draper's handwritten studio notes, and the 1995 BBC Radio 1 John Peel Session.
- **2014 Chester Mansun Convention World Premiere:** Filmed the first public playback of Paul Draper's debut solo song (*"Feeling My Heart Run Slow"*) at the Mansun convention in Chester (August 2014).
  - Credited by **Louder Than War** (Martin Leay) to *"Richard Murray of the Paul-Draper.net fansite"*.
  - Named by **Vanyaland** as the person who captured the premiere recording.
  - Featured by **The Guardian** in its indie playlist coverage.
